edges.reason: mint consumes msg.sender as mint recipient, balance key and owner check value.
withdraw assigns msg.sender to the local variable used as the transfer destination.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against owner().
getCurrentYear derives the year from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
makeArt uses the current year to compute the artwork score.
tokenURI calls makeArt to obtain the SVG art data.
tokenURI prefixes its output with _baseURI().
mint calls _safeMint, which performs an external receiver callback.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received before state finalization.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call into the recipient contract.
_safeMint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook via _mint.
withdraw performs a native value transfer to msg.sender.
mint increments totalSupply and uses it as the new token id.
mint calls _setOGs to persist the OG count.
mint calls _setMintingYear to persist the minting year.
mint increments the caller's artBalance entry.
royaltyInfo returns _royaltiesReceiver as the payment receiver.
royaltyInfo uses royaltiesPercentage in the royalty computation.
setRoyaltiesReceiver (owner-only) writes _royaltiesReceiver.
setMintingActive (owner-only) writes the mintingActive flag.
mint gates execution on the mintingActive flag.
onlyOwner guards setRoyaltiesReceiver.
onlyOwner guards setMintingActive.
onlyOwner guards withdraw.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable through owner().
tokenURI reads _ogs[tokenId] to render metadata.
tokenURI reads _mintingYear[tokenId] to render metadata.
makeArt receives the OG count from _ogs through tokenURI.
makeArt receives the minting year from _mintingYear through tokenURI.
getCurrentYear converts block.timestamp to a year via timestamp2year.
_setOGs writes into the _ogs mapping.
_setMintingYear writes into the _mintingYear mapping.
the noYears argument is stored via _setOGs.
the mintingYear argument is stored via _setMintingYear.
the amount argument drives the withdrawal transfer size.
newRoyaltiesReceiver is assigned to _royaltiesReceiver.
isMintingActive is assigned to the mintingActive flag.
_tokenId is the queried token id in royaltyInfo.
_salePrice is multiplied by royaltiesPercentage in royaltyInfo.
tokenId selects which _ogs/_mintingYear entries tokenURI uses.
withdraw stores msg.sender into the local variable someone.
the local address someone is the recipient of the value transfer.
royaltyInfo computes the royalty amount into the local _royalties.

normalization_plan.reason: noYears is stored into _ogs through _setOGs, so it folds into that core operation.
mintingYear is stored into _mintingYear through _setMintingYear, so it folds into that core operation.
amount exists only to size the transfer inside withdraw.
newRoyaltiesReceiver is the sole input written by setRoyaltiesReceiver.
isMintingActive is the sole input written by setMintingActive.
_tokenId is only used as the lookup key inside royaltyInfo.
_salePrice is only used in the royalty computation inside royaltyInfo.
tokenId is only used to index storage while building metadata in tokenURI.
someone is the recipient of the native value transfer, folding into the unsafe transfer operation.
_royalties is the computed return value produced inside royaltyInfo.
